SWT301 — PE Practice 3 (SU26 format)

ExamEligibility review · checkScholarship unit tests (3-condition AND, short-circuit MC/DC) · Gym Membership Fee black-box · 85 minutes · 10 marks

1. Overview

This paper follows the SU26 practical-exam format of SWT301 (template SWT301_SU26_Template.xlsx: sheet Q1 issue list · sheet Q2 UTCID grid · sheet Q3 test cases). It is a NEW paper written in the style of the real ones — and it goes further: your corrected code is executed, your coverage is measured on instrumented code, and every test case you write is run against a reference implementation of the specification.

Rules of the real paper (keep them while practising): 85 minutes; no IDE; answers in English; every answer must reflect THIS paper — irrelevant keywords give zero for that question; expected results always come from the specification, never from the code.

How answers are recorded here: each sheet of the template becomes one JavaScript file that declares an array — one object per row/column of the template (see “Data model”). Edit only the files in answers/.

Main features

  • Question 1 (3 marks) — review ExamEligibility.canTakeFinalExam: at least 8 issues with line, type and fix; then correct the method.
  • Question 2 (3 marks) — the MINIMUM unit test cases for 100% statement coverage, 100% decision coverage and MC/DC of the compound conditions of checkScholarship.
  • Question 3 (4 marks) — black-box test cases for the Gym Membership Fee function: validation · business rules (decision table) · boundary values.

General requirements

  • Expected results come from the SPECIFICATION. When the code disagrees, the test case FAILS — that is your finding.
  • Use concrete values. Strings exactly as the specification prints them.
  • Question 2 is graded like the template rule: marks ÷ minimum number of tests — an extra test case costs marks.

2. Required project structure

answers/
├── q1-issues.js      ← Question 1  : const ISSUES = [...]       (sheet Q1)
├── q1-fixed.js       ← Question 1  : function canTakeFinalExam(...)   (corrected — JavaScript twin)
├── q2-utcid.js       ← Question 2  : const UTCIDS = [...]       (sheet Q2 — one object per UTCID column)
└── q3-testcases.js   ← Question 3  : const TEST_CASES = [...]   (sheet Q3 — one object per row)

3. UI wireframe

+----------------------------------------------------------------+
|                     GYM MEMBERSHIP FEE                         |
+----------------------------------------------------------------+
|  Member ID       [ e.g. GM001                              ]   |
|  Age             [ 16 - 80                                 ]   |
|  Plan            [ -- Select plan --                     v ]   |  Monthly / Quarterly / Yearly
|  PT Sessions     [ 0 - 20                                  ]   |
|  Student Card    [ -- Select --                          v ]   |  Yes / No
|                                                                |
|                       [ Calculate Fee ]                        |
|  Total Fee: 480,000 VND.                                       |
+----------------------------------------------------------------+

4. Data model

Answer records — ISSUES[i] · UTCIDS[i] · TEST_CASES[i]

FieldTypeNotes
ISSUES[i].linenumber | "2-4"line number(s) in the listing of Question 1
ISSUES[i].typestringone of LOGIC, BOUNDARY, CALCULATION, VALIDATION, EXCEPTION, DATA_TYPE, COMPILE, TEST_DATA, CONVENTION, PERFORMANCE, SECURITY, RESOURCE

TEST_CASES[i].dataobject{ memberId, age, plan, ptSessions, studentCard } — strings as typed/selected ("" = empty / not selected)

Sample data

{ line: 16, type: 'COMPILE', severity: 'High', description: 'Missing semicolon after return false.', fix: 'return false;' }
// answers/q2-utcid.js
{ id: 'UTCID01', input: { gpa: -0.1, credits: 20, hasViolation: false }, expected: 'Invalid GPA', type: 'A', status: 'P' }
// answers/q3-testcases.js
{
    id: 'A01', description: 'Verify that an empty Member ID is rejected',
    precondition: 'User is on the Gym Membership Fee screen; members GM001–GM003 exist',
    steps: ['Enter Member ID = (empty)', 'Enter Age = 30', 'Select Plan = Monthly', 'Enter PT Sessions = 0', 'Select Student Card = No', 'Click Calculate Fee'],
    data: { memberId: '', age: '30', plan: 'Monthly', ptSessions: '0', studentCard: 'No' },
    expected: 'Member ID is required.',
  }

5. Functional requirements

1. Q1.1 — Issue list (code review) 2 marks

Problem description — final-exam eligibility. canTakeFinalExam(statuses, feePaid) decides whether a student may sit the final exam:

  • statuses holds one status per class slot: exactly "PRESENT", "ABSENT" or "LATE". A null or empty list, or any other value (including null items), is invalid ⇒ IllegalArgumentException.
  • Absence rate = (ABSENT + 0.5 × LATE) ÷ number of slots × 100.
  • The student may take the exam when the absence rate is at most 20% and the fee is paid.
  • The method is called once per student; one call must not influence the next.
 1  import java.util.List;
 2  
 3  public class ExamEligibility {
 4      static int lateCount;
 5  
 6      public static boolean canTakeFinalExam(List<String> statuses, boolean feePaid) {
 7          int absent = 0;
 8          for (String s : statuses) {
 9              if (s == "ABSENT") absent++;
10              else if (s.equals("LATE")) lateCount++;
11          }
12          double rate = (absent + lateCount / 2) / statuses.size() * 100;
13          if (rate < 20 || feePaid) {
14              return true;
15          }
16          return false
17      }
18  
19      public static void main(String[] args) {
20          List<String> week = List.of("PRESENT", "ABSENT", "Late");
21          System.out.println(canTakeFinalExam(week, true));
22      }
23  }

Issue types: LOGIC wrong condition/flow · BOUNDARY off-by-one, > vs >= · CALCULATION wrong formula/unit · VALIDATION missing input check · EXCEPTION crash risk (NPE, index, divide by 0) · DATA_TYPE wrong type, integer division, overflow, double for money · COMPILE does not compile · TEST_DATA demo/test data breaks the spec · CONVENTION magic number, naming, formatting · PERFORMANCE · SECURITY · RESOURCE unclosed stream/connection

Requirements:

  • Find at least 8 distinct issues. One object = one issue; it counts when its line AND type match a real defect.
  • Every issue has a concrete fix. Do not report legal code as a compile error.

Must use: checklist-based review desk checking

2. Q1.2 — Corrected method (runs for real) 1 mark

Requirements:

  • In answers/q1-fixed.js fix the twin canTakeFinalExam(statuses, feePaid) so that it satisfies the specification — including “one call must not influence the next”.
  • Invalid input throws IllegalArgumentException.

Must use: debugging confirmation testing

Example:

canTakeFinalExam(['ABSENT', 'PRESENT', 'PRESENT', 'PRESENT', 'PRESENT'], true) → true   (exactly 20%)

3. Q2.1 — Coverage with the minimum test set 1.5 marks

Method description. checkScholarship decides the scholarship of a student for the next term. A GPA outside 0.0–4.0 returns "Invalid GPA". A student with a disciplinary violation gets no scholarship ("None"). Otherwise: GPA ≥ 3.6 with at least 15 credits this term → "Full Scholarship"; GPA ≥ 3.2 with at least 15 credits → "Half Scholarship"; else "None". The caller guarantees credits ≥ 0.

1  public static String checkScholarship(double gpa, int credits, boolean hasViolation) {
2      if (gpa < 0 || gpa > 4)
3          return "Invalid GPA";
4      if (gpa >= 3.6 && credits >= 15 && !hasViolation)
5          return "Full Scholarship";
6      if (gpa >= 3.2 && credits >= 15)
7          return "Half Scholarship";
8      return "None";
9  }

Requirements:

  • Choose the minimum number of test cases for 100% statement coverage, 100% decision coverage and MC/DC of ALL THREE compound conditions (lines 2, 4 and 6).
  • Short-circuit: a condition that is not evaluated may differ freely inside an independence pair (masking MC/DC — the rule accepted for Java/C/JS).

Must use: statement coverage decision coverage MC/DC

4. Q2.2 — UTCID grid: expected, type, result 1.5 marks

Requirements:

  • expected = the SPECIFICATION (read the violation rule carefully). status = "P" when the code returns it, else "F".
  • type: A for an invalid GPA, B or N on the edges (GPA 0, 3.2, 3.6, 4.0 or 14/15 credits), otherwise N.

Must use: UTCID template N/A/B

5. Q3.A — Validation test cases 1 mark

Function description. A gym computes the fee of a new membership.

Fields: Member ID — required; IDs in the system: GM001, GM002, GM003. Age — required, an integer 16–80. Plan — required (Monthly / Quarterly / Yearly). PT Sessions (personal-trainer sessions) — required, an integer 0–20. Student Card — required (Yes / No).

When the user clicks Calculate Fee the system performs these steps in order and stops at the first error:

  1. Member ID: empty → Member ID is required.; not in the system → Invalid Member ID.
  2. Age: empty → Age is required.; not an integer 16–80 → Age must be an integer from 16 to 80.
  3. Plan: not selected → Plan is required.
  4. PT Sessions: empty → PT Sessions is required.; not an integer 0–20 → PT Sessions must be an integer from 0 to 20.
  5. Student Card: not selected → Student Card is required.
  6. Calculate the fee:
    • Plan price: Monthly 600,000 · Quarterly 1,620,000 · Yearly 5,760,000 VND.
    • Discount on the plan price — only one applies: age ≥ 60 → 30%; otherwise a student card with age ≤ 25 → 20%; otherwise none.
    • PT sessions: 250,000 VND each; when 10 or more sessions are bought, every session costs 200,000.
    • Total = discounted plan price + PT sessions.
  7. Display Total Fee: [x] VND. with thousands separators.

Calculation examples

AgeStudent cardPlanPT sessionsCalculationResult
20YesMonthly0600,000 × 80%480,000
30YesMonthly0no discount600,000
65NoQuarterly01,620,000 × 70%1,134,000
30NoMonthly5600,000 + 5 × 250,0001,850,000
30NoMonthly12600,000 + 12 × 200,0003,000,000
22YesYearly05,760,000 × 80%4,608,000

Requirements:

  • One test case for EVERY message, and for each different reason behind a shared message (age: text, decimal, too low, too high; PT: negative, too high).

Must use: equivalence partitioning test case template

6. Q3.B — Business rules (reduced decision table) 2 marks

Requirements:

  • Reduced decision table for the discount: R1 card + age ≤ 25 · R2 card + age 26–59 · R3 age ≥ 60 (card does not matter — test it WITH a card too) · R4 no card, age < 60.
  • PT rules R5 (0 sessions), R6 (1–9), R7 (10–20) and every plan (Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly).

Must use: decision table testing

7. Q3.C — Boundary values 1 mark

Requirements:

  • Age 15 | 16, 25 | 26 (with a card), 59 | 60, 80 | 81; PT 9 | 10 and 20 | 21.

Must use: 2-value BVA

6. Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
ISSUESanswers/q1-issues.js — Question 1 issue list
canTakeFinalExam(…)answers/q1-fixed.js — corrected method
UTCIDSanswers/q2-utcid.js — UTCID columns of Question 2
TEST_CASESanswers/q3-testcases.js — test cases of Question 3

7. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1Q1.1 — Issue list (code review)2
2Q1.2 — Corrected method (runs for real)1
3Q2.1 — Coverage with the minimum test set1.5
4Q2.2 — UTCID grid: expected, type, result1.5
5Q3.A — Validation test cases1
6Q3.B — Business rules (reduced decision table)2
7Q3.C — Boundary values1
Total10

Common deductions

  • Q2 with 7 tests: a separate (T,T) test for line 6 is redundant — the violation case already reaches line 6 with (T,T).
  • Q2: writing "Half Scholarship" as expected for a student with a violation (copied from the code).
  • Q1: reporting List.of as a compile error, or saying "== works because literals are interned" — it works only by accident.
  • Q3: testing the senior discount only without a card — the conflict “card + age ≥ 60” is exactly where implementations go wrong (50% instead of 30%).

8. Submission

Write your answers in the answer files on the right (they mirror the official template: one JavaScript object per test case / issue). Press Run for the visible checks and Submit for full grading, hidden checks included. Your score per question appears in the rubric table.

5. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. Q1.1 — Danh sách lỗi (review mã) 2 điểm

Mô tả bài toán — điều kiện dự thi cuối kỳ. canTakeFinalExam(statuses, feePaid) quyết định sinh viên có được thi cuối kỳ:

  • statuses có một trạng thái cho mỗi buổi học: đúng "PRESENT", "ABSENT" hoặc "LATE". Danh sách null hoặc rỗng, hay bất kỳ giá trị nào khác (kể cả phần tử null), là dữ liệu sai ⇒ IllegalArgumentException.
  • Tỉ lệ vắng = (ABSENT + 0,5 × LATE) ÷ số buổi × 100.
  • Sinh viên được thi khi tỉ lệ vắng không quá 20% và đã đóng học phí.
  • Phương thức được gọi một lần cho mỗi sinh viên; lần gọi này không được ảnh hưởng lần sau.
 1  import java.util.List;
 2  
 3  public class ExamEligibility {
 4      static int lateCount;
 5  
 6      public static boolean canTakeFinalExam(List<String> statuses, boolean feePaid) {
 7          int absent = 0;
 8          for (String s : statuses) {
 9              if (s == "ABSENT") absent++;
10              else if (s.equals("LATE")) lateCount++;
11          }
12          double rate = (absent + lateCount / 2) / statuses.size() * 100;
13          if (rate < 20 || feePaid) {
14              return true;
15          }
16          return false
17      }
18  
19      public static void main(String[] args) {
20          List<String> week = List.of("PRESENT", "ABSENT", "Late");
21          System.out.println(canTakeFinalExam(week, true));
22      }
23  }

Loại lỗi: LOGIC sai điều kiện/luồng · BOUNDARY lệch một, > với >= · CALCULATION sai công thức/đơn vị · VALIDATION thiếu kiểm đầu vào · EXCEPTION nguy cơ văng lỗi (NPE, chỉ số, chia 0) · DATA_TYPE sai kiểu, chia nguyên, tràn số, double cho tiền · COMPILE không biên dịch được · TEST_DATA dữ liệu demo/test trái đặc tả · CONVENTION số ma thuật, đặt tên, định dạng · PERFORMANCE hiệu năng · SECURITY bảo mật · RESOURCE không đóng stream/kết nối

Yêu cầu:

  • Tìm ít nhất 8 lỗi khác nhau. Mỗi object = một lỗi; được tính khi đúng dòng VÀ đúng loại.
  • Mỗi lỗi có cách sửa cụ thể. Không báo mã hợp lệ là lỗi biên dịch.

Bắt buộc dùng: checklist-based review desk checking

2. Q1.2 — Phương thức đã sửa (chạy thật) 1 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • Trong answers/q1-fixed.js sửa bản sinh đôi canTakeFinalExam(statuses, feePaid) cho đúng đặc tả — kể cả “lần gọi này không ảnh hưởng lần sau”.
  • Dữ liệu sai ném IllegalArgumentException.

Bắt buộc dùng: debugging confirmation testing

Ví dụ:

canTakeFinalExam(['ABSENT', 'PRESENT', 'PRESENT', 'PRESENT', 'PRESENT'], true) → true   (đúng 20%)

3. Q2.1 — Đạt độ phủ với bộ test tối thiểu 1.5 điểm

Mô tả phương thức. checkScholarship quyết định học bổng kỳ sau. GPA ngoài 0.0–4.0 trả "Invalid GPA". Sinh viên vi phạm kỷ luật không nhận học bổng nào ("None"). Ngược lại: GPA ≥ 3.6 và ít nhất 15 tín chỉ trong kỳ → "Full Scholarship"; GPA ≥ 3.2 và ít nhất 15 tín chỉ → "Half Scholarship"; còn lại "None". Bên gọi đảm bảo credits ≥ 0.

1  public static String checkScholarship(double gpa, int credits, boolean hasViolation) {
2      if (gpa < 0 || gpa > 4)
3          return "Invalid GPA";
4      if (gpa >= 3.6 && credits >= 15 && !hasViolation)
5          return "Full Scholarship";
6      if (gpa >= 3.2 && credits >= 15)
7          return "Half Scholarship";
8      return "None";
9  }

Yêu cầu:

  • Chọn số ca tối thiểu cho 100% statement, 100% decision và MC/DC cho CẢ BA điều kiện ghép (dòng 2, 4 và 6).
  • Ngắn mạch: điều kiện không được đánh giá thì được phép khác nhau trong cặp độc lập (MC/DC có che — luật được chấp nhận cho Java/C/JS).

Bắt buộc dùng: statement coverage decision coverage MC/DC

4. Q2.2 — Lưới UTCID: mong đợi, loại, kết quả 1.5 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • expected = theo ĐẶC TẢ (đọc kỹ luật vi phạm). status = "P" khi mã trả đúng, ngược lại "F".
  • type: A cho GPA sai, B hay N ở các mép (GPA 0, 3.2, 3.6, 4.0 hoặc 14/15 tín chỉ), còn lại N.

Bắt buộc dùng: UTCID template N/A/B

5. Q3.A — Test case kiểm hợp lệ 1 điểm

Mô tả chức năng. Phòng tập tính phí đăng ký hội viên mới.

Các trường: Member ID — bắt buộc; mã có trong hệ thống: GM001, GM002, GM003. Age — bắt buộc, số nguyên 16–80. Plan — bắt buộc (Monthly / Quarterly / Yearly). PT Sessions (số buổi huấn luyện viên riêng) — bắt buộc, số nguyên 0–20. Student Card — bắt buộc (Yes / No).

Khi bấm Calculate Fee hệ thống làm các bước theo thứ tự và dừng ở lỗi đầu tiên:

  1. Member ID: trống → Member ID is required.; không có trong hệ thống → Invalid Member ID.
  2. Age: trống → Age is required.; không phải số nguyên 16–80 → Age must be an integer from 16 to 80.
  3. Plan: chưa chọn → Plan is required.
  4. PT Sessions: trống → PT Sessions is required.; không phải số nguyên 0–20 → PT Sessions must be an integer from 0 to 20.
  5. Student Card: chưa chọn → Student Card is required.

Question 1

Line 9 compares references; line 4 + 10 keep late slots in a static field that leaks into the next student; line 12 has TWO integer divisions (late / 2, then ÷ size before × 100); line 13 uses < instead of <= and || instead of &&; line 16 misses a semicolon. Question 2

Line 4 is A && B && C ⇒ (T,T,T) plus each condition false alone: 4 valid tests. Line 6 needs (T,T), (T,F) and (F,·) — all three come from the same four tests thanks to short-circuit masking: the violation case reaches line 6 with (T,T), the low-credit case with (T,F), the GPA-3.0 case with (F,·). Two invalid GPAs for line 2 ⇒ 6. The violation case is F: the spec says "None", the code says "Half Scholarship" (defect: line 6 forgets the violation rule).

@ParameterizedTest
@CsvSource({ "-0.1,20,false,Invalid GPA", "4.1,20,false,Invalid GPA", "3.8,20,false,Full Scholarship",
             "3.8,10,false,None", "3.8,20,true,None", "3.0,20,false,None" })
void checkScholarship(double gpa, int credits, boolean violation, String expected) {
    assertEquals(expected, Scholarship.checkScholarship(gpa, credits, violation)); // row 5 fails → BUG on line 6
}

Question 3

The discount rule has two conditions (card, age band with three values) but only four distinct outcomes, so the reduced decision table has four rules with one "don't care" (age ≥ 60). Test the don't-care BOTH ways — that is where "applied both discounts" bugs hide. BVA: 15|16, 25|26 with a card, 59|60, 80|81, PT 9|10 (10 sessions are cheaper than 9 — a real finding to report) and 20|21.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi:
Câu 1

Dòng 9 so tham chiếu; dòng 4 + 10 giữ số buổi muộn trong biến static rò sang sinh viên sau; dòng 12 có HAI phép chia nguyên (late / 2, rồi ÷ size trước khi × 100); dòng 13 dùng < thay <= và || thay &&; dòng 16 thiếu chấm phẩy. Dòng 12 (nới kiểu) và dòng 20 (List.of) vẫn biên dịch — báo chúng là lỗi biên dịch là khẳng định sai.

Câu 2

Dòng 4 là A && B && C ⇒ (T,T,T) và mỗi điều kiện sai một mình: 4 ca hợp lệ. Dòng 6 cần (T,T), (T,F), (F,·) — cả ba lấy từ chính 4 ca đó nhờ che do ngắn mạch. Hai GPA sai cho dòng 2 ⇒ 6 ca. Ca vi phạm là F: đặc tả nói "None", mã trả "Half Scholarship" (lỗi: dòng 6 quên luật vi phạm).

Câu 3

Luật giảm giá có hai điều kiện (thẻ, nhóm tuổi ba giá trị) nhưng chỉ bốn kết quả khác nhau, nên bảng quyết định rút gọn còn bốn luật với một ô "không quan tâm" (tuổi ≥ 60). Hãy test ô không quan tâm theo CẢ hai phía — lỗi "cộng dồn hai mức giảm" nấp ở đó. BVA: 15|16, 25|26 khi có thẻ, 59|60, 80|81, PT 9|10 (10 buổi rẻ hơn 9 — phát hiện đáng báo) và 20|21.
